FTD-class combined (FTD + FTD-MND, n=128): d=+0.257 (p=0.152). Weak elevated, intermediate between AD (d=+0.68) and PSP/CBD (d=-0.38). Per-cell-type top negative effects (none Bonferroni-sig, all *): NK-cells d=-0.369, MPP d=-0.367, granulocytes d=-0.360, Neutrophils d=-0.355, Neutro -0.351. Pattern resembles AIBL AD's immune-class negative direction but weaker — tauopathy-class crossover. The differential vs AD on the 115-cell hyper-volume is real: AD shows broad positive multi-class signal (Cortical_neurons +1.27, Pancreatic_beta +1.29, stem_pluri +1.29), while FTD shows immune-class negative shifts with no extreme positives.

v3.0 POST-BUILD ADDENDUM (CPG-VAL-014) — GIFT GSE53740 PSP n=43 + CBD n=1 vs HC n=193 (450K). Mahalanobis hyper-volume: PSP d=-0.380 (p=2.3e-6 highly significant). PSP+CBD combined: d=-0.378 (p=3.0e-6). DIRECTION IS NEGATIVE — PSP/CBD samples have REDUCED Mahalanobis distance from HC centroid (architectural compaction, BELOW-NORMAL signature). Confirms v2.2 BELOW_NORMAL tier directly via the universal hyper-volume metric. Per-cell-type effects: 7 Bonferroni-sig negative effects (Bonf p<4.35e-04): Baso d=-0.686, LE d=-0.645, Microglia d=-0.627, smooth_muscle d=-0.613, Mela d=-0.586 (top 5 listed). The breadth of negative effects across non-immune cells (smooth_muscle, melanocytes, basophils, microglia) is a distinctive PSP/CBD signature absent in both AD and FTD on GIFT. Strongest differentiator from AD in the post-build differential: PSP/CBD compacted (d<-0.3), AD distended (d>+0.5).
